references.text: Moses asked God for a sign, and God answered by performing miracles as confirmation
Elijah asked God to show Himself through signs, and God answered with fire from heaven
God offered King Ahaz a sign, showing His willingness to confirm His promises through visible signs
Abraham's servant asked God for a sign to find a wife for Isaac, and God answered
God has power over nature and can send dew and manna from heaven according to His will
